title: Grateful Dead Live at Scope on 1982-04-03

ai_review.summary: A rough‑around‑the‑edges soundboard of an early‑'80s show that still dazzles with a scorching Scarlet > Fire transition, gorgeous Peggy‑O and vibrant Jerry vocals.
ai_review.review: Despite the patchy soundboard—typical of 1982 recordings with audience bleed and occasional drop‑outs—the performance shines. Highlights include an explosive Scarlet > Fire jam, a soaring Peggy‑O, and tight playing from the whole band, especially Jerry’s vocal inflection and Bob’s guitar work. Energy is high throughout, though a few moments feel sloppy or lazy.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical performance (many 5‑star comments) while noting consistent recording flaws; weighting show quality higher yields a rating just above 4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Typical early‑'80s SBD with audience patches and occasional drop‑outs; some describe it as 'shitty for the period' but others say it sounds fine for an 82–85 board. Overall listenable but not pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong flow highlighted by the seamless Scarlet‑Fire transition and cohesive jams; a few sloppy spots but overall an engaging, exploratory set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeated praise for his vocal inflection on Scarlet and overall voice; noted for ‘licks and plucks’ that make the Peggy‑O version special.
band_member_comments.Bob: Several reviewers call Bob’s guitar work 'stellar' during the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's focused grand‑piano playing, especially on the Estimated > Eyes outro, receives positive mention.
